title: Columbia University Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Columbia University Taiwanese Student Association (CUTSA / 哥倫比亞大學臺灣同學會) is a non-profit, student-run organization at Columbia University composed of Taiwanese students currently enrolled at the university. It operates as a non-political, non-religious organization open to graduate students, faculty, and alumni, with a focus on supporting students from Taiwan who are studying in the greater New York area.

According to its official About page, CUTSA is dedicated to enhancing the social network among its members and assists prospective students in making a successful transition into life at Columbia. Its stated mission is to create a platform for members to exchange ideas, participate in activities with other organizations, broaden cultural exposure, and improve quality of life. The organization holds academic, cultural, and social events throughout the year.

CUTSA maintains an active Tumblr-based website (cutsa.tumblr.com) listing current board members, an Instagram account (@columbiatsa — 紐約哥倫比亞大學台灣學生會), and a Facebook group. The Tumblr site carries a copyright notice spanning 2015–2025, indicating continuous operation over at least a decade.
